en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside scene with large leafy trees in the foreground, two people standing on a sloping sandy bank, boats and a calm river, and an ornate multi‑storey brick building on the opposite shore. The caption at the bottom reads "Strömsholmen, Norrköping." Typical early 20th‑century chromolithographic style with a wide blank margin at the bottom.
